reproduction: `bootstrap-v2.sh --mode execute` started `opip-canonical-writer` before any canonical recovery existed
root_cause: writer lifecycle was bundled with first-install instead of being a post-recovery gate
correction: execute starts core only and refuses if a writer is running; new `--mode activate-writer` requires a bound PASS recovery receipt and proves exactly one writer

reproduction: Compose project read from `$SRC=/srv/...` while `.env`, data and the DB were read from `$APP_ROOT=/opt/...`; preflight used `--env-file \$SRC/.env\"`"
root_cause: two competing roots were never reconciled against the certified controller
correction: one contract: APP_ROOT holds compose, .env, data, DB; /srv is an immutable install source resolved by `resolve_src` and installed with a manifest

reproduction: `cp -a data/opip/canonical` of a live WAL-mode database while only the container was stopped
root_cause: directory copy is not a consistent SQLite snapshot
correction: snapshot via the SQLite online backup API after proving the writer stopped, then integrity_check + foreign_key_check and a recorded SHA-256

reproduction: two staged files, the alphabetically later one conflicting: the earlier file was already copied
root_cause: conflict detection happened inside the copy loop
correction: two-phase promotion: preflight every file then copy; refusal performs 0 writes

reproduction: a symlinked directory in staging/target redirected a write outside the root
root_cause: `root / rel` used without containment or symlink checks
correction: `_safe_destination()` rejects absolute paths, dot components, escapes and symlinked ancestors

reproduction: a stale PREPARED receipt and an earlier AUTHORIZED receipt were both reusable
root_cause: receipts carried no digest, expiry, or prepared->authorized link
correction: receipts carry digest + 60-minute expiry + nonce; AUTHORIZED embeds the PREPARED digest; execute revalidates host/SHA/image/config and consumes the authorization

reproduction: same-epoch writes were accepted because only `history_epoch` was compared
root_cause: sequence/event-count were read but never enforced
correction: compare refuses any advance of epoch, next_local_sequence or event_count, plus integrity/FK failures

reproduction: 270/209 CRLF lines in the delivered scripts made Linux `bash -n` fail
root_cause: editor wrote CRLF and no `.gitattributes` pinned LF
correction: scripts normalized to LF (0 CRLF verified on disk and in the shipped ZIP); `.gitattributes` pins `*.sh text eol=lf`

root_cause: runbooks drifted from the hardened entrypoints
correction: runbooks rewritten against the real parameters; promotion requires `-RecoveryReceipt`

reproduction: `assert ... not in ... or True` could never fail
root_cause: a disjunction with a truthy literal
correction: replaced with concrete assertions plus a repo-wide scan that fails on any vacuous assertion

reproduction: PreBootstrap required >=1 canonical backup while the final V1 generation only arrives after bootstrap
root_cause: rehearsal seed and final generation were conflated
correction: PreBootstrap records the count as SKIP evidence and gates nothing; the final generation is verified after transfer

reproduction: the 44-entry ZIP could not run 30 of its own tests without the certified source
root_cause: fixtures import app.opip.canonical.* and need the certified Compose
correction: certified source verified at the pinned SHA (1217 files, 0 mismatches) and the suite executed against it; the package records the pin
status: PARTIAL: resolved here, needs an independently pinned checkout

reproduction: after the rewrite, `mode_prepare` and `preflight_evaluate` bodies sat at top level without their headers
root_cause: a header line used as an edit anchor was consumed
correction: headers restored; a structural test fails on statements outside a function and on unbalanced braces

reproduction: `[[ -L ... ]] && die` and `[[ -d ... ]] && mounts+=(...)` abort the script under `set -e` when the test is false
root_cause: an AND-list at statement level returns 1 when the left side is false

reproduction: prepare computed the config digest while APP_ROOT was empty, so execute always refused
correction: digest falls back to the verified release compose file before installation

reproduction: two `prepare` runs in the same second produced byte-identical receipts, so an earlier authorization stayed valid
root_cause: receipt timestamps are truncated to seconds and the payload had no unique element
correction: prepared receipts carry a random nonce, so re-preparing always invalidates an earlier authorization

reproduction: on a genuinely fresh host, `execute` created `$APP_ROOT/data` before installing, so the install saw a non-empty root and refused
root_cause: the foreign-content check treated a pre-created `data/` as untrusted content, and the install ran after directory creation
correction: install the release first; the foreign-content check ignores `data/`
